changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/root-document-migration-guide.md with a 17-file root Markdown inventory, stay-root guidance, migration order, compatibility rules, docs-only reference-update rules, NAV requirement, and scope boundary audit. Updated docs/requirements/NAV.md to include the new guide and keep the decision-doc count at 36.
usage: Read docs/requirements/decisions/root-document-migration-guide.md before opening a future story that moves root Markdown files. Use docs/requirements/NAV.md to find the guide under Requirements Decision Navigation.
expectedOutcome: A human or agent can see which root Markdown files should remain root entrypoints, which can later move into requirements docs, and which future policy rows are explicitly deferred without claiming Production Safety or unattended readiness.
actualTranscript: node ../../bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-b5b2 --json returned status=pass and allPass=true. It ran npm test successfully and reported verification coverage 9/9 covered for CHK-001, CHK-002, and CHK-003.
outcomeDiff: No user-value difference: actual output matches the expected docs-only migration guide and NAV update. No root Markdown files were moved, renamed, or deleted.
limitations: This story intentionally documents migration policy only. It does not perform root file moves, unlock Production Safety, assert authority or unattended readiness, or claim any new global capability.
pitfalls: Reviewer feedback caught two real correctness issues: future target rows initially pointed at non-existent decision files, and one reference-update rule expanded into code or prompt cleanup. Both were narrowed to explicit TBD/no-claim states and Markdown-doc-only scope.
